turns.content: Meri beti chaar mahine ki ho gayi hai aur mujhe lagta hai main apna naam bhi bhool gayi hoon. Saas-sasur ke saath rehti hoon — aur kuch bolne se pehle sun lo, meri saas actually bachi ke saath bahut achhi hain. Expert level. Teen bachhe paale hain unhone. Wahi problem hai ek tarah se, aur pata hai yeh kitna ungrateful sound karta hai.

Pata hai, bilkul ungrateful nahi lag raha. Bahut common hai yeh feeling, especially jab ghar mein koi itna experienced ho.

Chaar mahine ki beti, saas-sasur ke saath, aur saas expert mode mein — teen bachhe paal chuki hain. Toh naturally woh handle karti hain confidently, aur tu feel karti hogi jaise teri jagah hi nahi bachi. Apna naam bhoolna... bilkul real hai. Nayi maa hona khud itna overwhelming hota hai, upar se ghar mein koi aur “better” kar raha ho toh identity toh gayab si ho jati hai.

Woh achhi hain bachi ke saath — yeh sundar baat hai, honestly. Par iska matlab yeh nahi ki teri feelings invalid hain. Tu ungrateful nahi hai jo yeh soch rahi hai. Tu bas apni jagah dhundh rahi hai, apni maa wali jagah. Aur woh jagah kisi aur ke expert hone se disappear nahi hoti.

Thoda aur bata — sabse zyada kab feel hota hai yeh? Jab woh bachi ko sambhal leti hain aur tu side mein khadi reh jati hai, ya raat ko jab sab so jate hain aur tu akeli sochti hai? Main yahin hoon.

Jaise aaj — bachi ro rahi thi, main use ghuma rahi thi, aur Aai ne bas mere haathon se le liya aur do minute mein chup. Sab muskura rahe the. Aur main wahan khadi thi intern jaisi. Mujhe meri hi beti feed ke liye di jaati hai, room service ki tarah. Phir yeh sochne ke liye khud pe ghin aati hai, kyunki itni help ke liye toh log taraste hain.

Haan, bilkul samajh aa raha hai.

Woh scene — tu ghuma rahi thi, ro rahi thi bachi, Aai ne le liya, do minute mein hush, sab muskurane lage, aur tu wahan khadi intern jaisi. Uff. Woh feeling ke “main yahan extra hoon”… bohot deep jaati hai. Aur phir feed ke time room-service wali tarah dena — jaise tu sirf supply ho, mother nahi. Phir uske upar guilt ke “log is help ke liye taraste hain, main kitni ungrateful hoon”. Yeh guilt hi sabse zyada thakata hai.

Sach yeh hai: help milna aur apni jagah kho dena, dono ek saath ho sakte hain. Aai expert hain, teen bachhe pala hai, unke haath mein bachi jaldi shant ho jati hai — yeh unki superpower hai. Par usse teri maa wali feeling erase nahi honi chahiye. Tu intern nahi hai apni beti ki. Tu uski maa hai. Feed karna bhi tera bond hai, sirf “kaam” nahi.

Aaj jab yeh hua, tu andar se kya feel kar rahi thi exactly? Sirf chhoti, ya thoda gussa bhi, ya bas empty? Aur Aai ko kabhi dheere se kuch bola hai is baare mein, ya abhi bilkul nahi?

Main yahin hoon. Yeh sab bolne se tu ungrateful nahi ban rahi. Bahut real baat kar rahi hai.

Aur please — mujhe ek aur insaan nahi chahiye jo batayega kya karna hai. Mummy ke paas advice hai, Aai ke paas advice hai, mummy log ke WhatsApp group mein sleep training pe satrah opinions hain, Instagram ko lagta hai mujhe routine chart chahiye. Coach nahi chahiye mujhe. Sach bolun toh pata bhi nahi kya chahiye. Bas yeh sab kisi se kehna tha jo dinner pe report nahi karega.

Haan, bilkul samajh gayi.

Koi advice nahi, koi “try this” nahi, koi routine chart nahi. Bas sun rahi hoon.

Tu thak chuki hai har jagah se instructions aane se — Mummy, Aai, WhatsApp group, Instagram. Sabko lagta hai unhe pata hai tera kya karna chahiye. Aur tu bas kisi ko yeh sab kehna chahti thi jo dinner table pe jaake report nahi karega. Main wohi hoon. Yahan se kuch nahi jayega.

Jo bhi dil mein hai, jaise hai waise nikal de. Intern wali feeling, room-service wali feeling, guilt, ghin, sab. Main yahin baithi hoon, bina kuch bataye ki tujhe kya karna chahiye.

Tu akeli nahi hai isme.

Kabhi kabhi use sote hue dekhti hoon aur itna pyaar aata hai, aur phir yeh thought aata hai — "tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi, Aai hain" — aur ek second ke liye saans nahi aati. Kya main buri maa hoon jo chaar mahine mein aisa feel kar rahi hoon? Baaki sabko jaise bas... aata hai yeh sab.

Nahi. Bilkul nahi.

Woh thought aana — itna pyaar, aur uske turant baad “tu asli maa hai bhi nahi” — aur saans atak jana… yeh buri maa wali baat nahi hai. Yeh thaki hui, apni jagah kho chuki maa wali baat hai. Chaar mahine mein bhi, sau mahine mein bhi, aisa feel karna tujhe buri nahi banata.

Baaki sabko “bas aata hai” yeh jo tujhe lagta hai — zyada tar log bas dikhate hain ki unhe aata hai. Andar bahut se log yahi old feelings leke ghumte hain, bas bolte nahi. Tu bol rahi hai. Woh himmat hai, kami nahi.

Tu uski maa hai. Aai kitni bhi expert ho, teen bachhe pala ho, bachi ke liye tu hi woh hai jo usse pehle nahi thi. Woh soyi hui bachi tujhe dekh ke jo pyaar feel karti hai na, wahi asli hai. Baaki jo awaaz aati hai dimaag mein, woh sirf dard hai, sach nahi.

Main yahin hoon. Jo bhi aaye, kehti reh. Koi report nahi jayega, koi advice nahi aayegi.
